pitfalls: GraCeFul casualDefense.py sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to4,5,6,7 when DEBUG=True; must adapt device assignment without changing defense math.
GraCeFul JSON contains AddSent, but default --poisoner genbadnets_question replaces the entire poisoner dict. Always pass explicit CLI attack and inspect final effective config.
GradSentry README says default svd.json, but argparse defaults to ./genConfigs/GraCeFul.json, not present in pinned tree. Pass --config_path explicitly.
GradSentry parses --target_model but current main script does not apply it; actual model path is from JSON.
GradSentry svd.json threshold0.822 does not override default autoThreshold=True; automatic reliable KDE is the active decision path with fallback0.7.
GradSentry paper AddSent text is 'I watched this 3D movie last weekend', but CLI source uses 'I watch this 3D movie'. Use BadNets as initial positive anchor to avoid this paper/source discrepancy.
GraCeFul native trainer leaves lm_head trainable after adding LoRA to base_model; GradSentry explicitly freezes lm_head after detection and trains LoRA-only. These are different downstream recipes.

Poison labels are used by author code for plots/evaluation; their values must not enter feature normalization, threshold selection, clustering labels, or training decisions in the shared-task wrapper.

GraCeFul.transform: 2D DCT on full Vxd gradient, THEN keep first floor(V/8) rows and floor(d/8) columns

pca.projection: matmul full cropped feature matrix by V[:,:32] then sklearn StandardScaler

GraCeFul.selection: keep majority cluster; discard smaller cluster
forbidden_core_changes: oracle budget selected by poison labels

GradSentry.subsample: first floor(V/8) rows and floor(d/8) columns of gradient BEFORE SVD
GradSentry.score: entropy of normalized top16 singular values divided by log16
GradSentry.manual_threshold: 0.822 is stored in JSON but inactive in auto path
forbidden_core_changes: reverse score direction after seeing test labels
LoRA-gradient sketch substituted for lm_head matrix
endpoint model substituted for pretrained model

positive_anchor.qualification_rule_proposed: Check original mechanism works: high poison identification (proposal recall>=95%,F1>=90%), successful no-defense attack (proposal ASR>=80%), defended ASR<=5% and clean-score drop<=3pp. These bands are proposal validation criteria, not author's exact seed-specific acceptance criteria; do not claim numeric paper reproduction from merely passing them.
positive_anchor.downstream_recipe: Use each author native recipe for this anchor and label their different lm_head update permissions. Native GraCeFul trains lm_head; native GradSentry does not. Separate cross-source sample IDs/splits must be hashed before comparison.
positive_anchor.model_availability: Requires existing authorized Llama-2-7b-chat-hf cache/access to count as native source anchor; availability and model revision not verified in this audit. Do not download now.

extra_graceful_risks: full gradient plus copied DCT input/output/FFT workspace; author torch.tensor(tensor) duplicates tensor
CPU feature list and torch.stack coexist during materialization; PCA workspaces add to stored features
hierarchical pairwise distance state grows quadratically; condensed float64 distances alone are~1.60GB atN20000, excluding extra workspaces
UMAP600dpi plots and silhouette score are diagnostics with additional cost
extra_gradsentry_risks: published claim onlyO(N)entropy scores does not describe current pinned correct(): it first stores all cropped gradients on CPU and only then loops SVD
float32 SVD transfer and workspace on GPU; retain one full lm_head gradient at a time
author exception fallback sets entropy1.0 on SVD failure; count/report every such failure rather than presenting it as successful defense evidence
engineering_adaptations_proposed: GradSentry: score each sample then retain scalar entropy only, preserving author math, threshold code and documented RNG behavior; require parity check, no execution now.

GraCeFul: consider disk-backed cropped features and blockwise equivalent PCA multiplication; do not replace DCT or hierarchical algorithm. Resource feasibility remains unresolved until an authorized bounded profile; OOM means measured infeasible at that resource budget, not method scientific failure.
resource_analysis.budget_basis: N extra per-sample gradient scoring operations before ordinary training; count GPU wall time, CPU feature/PCA/clustering wall time, RAM, storage I/O, model loading and downstream training. No defensible GPU-hour estimate before measurement; do not copy author H800 times to H20/Qwen3.

proposed_execution_units_if_later_author.positive_anchor: 6 native training runs: separate clean A0 / poisoned A1 / defense in GraCeFul head-trainable and GradSentry LoRA-only permission groups, plus two full5000 detector scans. Do not reuse A0/A1 across inconsistent native recipes. NOT LAUNCHED.
proposed_execution_units_if_later_author.main_first_root: 2 detector scans +2 shared downstream runs; reuse qualified existing A0/A1 only if artifacts and revisions match. LT units delegated to root. No cross-seed scan reuse until identical row content/model/loss/dtype verified.

resource_analysis.author_code_characterization: GraCeFul N-by-G feature storage and global PCA/hierarchical clustering are native algorithm costs; do not call them a bug or fix by random projection. GradSentry's all-gradient CPU list is an implementation memory mismatch with the paper's O(N)-score design; streaming is a proposed implementation adaptation requiring parity checks, not an established runtime result.
resource_analysis.proposed_bounded_check: If later authorized:128 rows only for resource measurement and independent-RNG gradient/entropy/mask parity; then decide whether20k is feasible.128-row resource/profile outputs are not defense efficacy evidence and do not replace full-dataset PCA/KDE/clustering.

minimum_native_alternative.paper_test_discrepancy: GraCeFulTable8=2032; GradSentryTable4=400, whereas both pinned dataset_info.json say2032 and processor loads source test without an apparent subsampling step. Prefer FreebaseQA5k if exact cross-paper split alignment is priority.
minimum_native_alternative.rationale: Smallest published complete author training benchmark, lower per-sample input length than FreebaseQA83.65 and contextual CoQA. No arbitrary further sample reduction.
minimum_native_alternative.native_config: GraCeFul genConfigs/GraCeFul.json and GradSentry genConfigs/svd.json already default WebQA; use explicit --dataset webqa --poisoner genbadnets_question and appropriate local model path.
minimum_native_alternative.caution: GradSentry WebQA BadNets paper identification F1=71.50, not>=90. FreebaseQA positive-anchor qualification bands must not be mechanically reused on WebQA.
